methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper describes an organisational methodology that complies with ISO 50 0 01, applied for the ﬁrst time to an Italian public body that manages a large building stock of social housing.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus on residential social housing without an industrial component.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The aim of the present study is to describe the approach adopted for the EnMS of the ALER building stock, highlighting the main aspects that determined this interesting and unique experience.

stage1.notes: Model content is present, but the registered exclusion applies because the application is exclusively residential social housing.
